models_evaluated: AI-based full-mouth radiograph series mounting interface

links.outcome: Student mounting accuracy and speed with versus without AI pre-mounting
links.effect: AI-assisted group mounted faster (p < 0.05) but was less accurate than manual mounting (p < 0.01), showing that AI use can change user performance.
links.quote: Accuracy was lower in the test groups, when comparing AI-assisted and manual mounting of FMS (p < 0.01).

links.outcome: Whether students corrected errors in AI-pre-mounted radiographs
links.effect: Students reviewing AI pre-mounted radiographs had decreased accuracy compared with manual mounting (p < 0.01), suggesting incorrect AI outputs were not always detected or corrected.
links.quote: Students with AI presented with a decreased accuracy in FMS radiograph mounting.
